name: @certen.io/sdk
description: TypeScript client for the CERTEN Gateway API — proof-gated cross-chain execution on Accumulate
//exports: Explicit map so a consumer on modern resolution gets the types; main/types stay for older toolchains.
//files: Only the build output and docs. src/ and test/ stay in the repo — declarationMap + sourceMap already give consumers navigable types, so shipping sources doubles the tarball for nothing.

scripts.//prepack: Build before packing so a published tarball can never carry a stale or missing dist/. That failure mode is nasty: the package installs cleanly and dies on first import.

//publishConfig: Provenance is passed as --provenance by .github/workflows/release.yml. Setting it here instead would break every publish outside CI with an error that does not explain itself.
